scenario: Gas detector in process area reads 12% LEL. Workers are still operating nearby equipment.
expected_decision: STOP WORK AUTHORITY — Lower Explosive Limit Threshold Exceeded

scenario: A worker asks if it is safe to mix two unlabelled chemical drums found in the storage area. No SDS or chemical identity is available.
expected_decision: INSUFFICIENT INFORMATION — Cannot determine safe decision without verified evidence
evidence_sources: Chemical identity must be confirmed before any compatibility assessment

scenario: An industrial hygienist measures a worker noise dose of 110% PEL after 6 hours in a fabrication workshop.
expected_decision: CORRECTIVE ACTION REQUIRED — Noise Dose Exceeds Permissible Exposure Limit

scenario: An electrician is working on a 415V panel without performing lockout/tagout. The panel remains energized.
expected_decision: LOTO REQUIRED — Stop Work on Energized Equipment
evidence_sources: NFPA 70E — Standard for Electrical Safety in the Workplace

scenario: Atmospheric test in a storage tank shows 16% oxygen before confined space entry.
expected_decision: ENTRY DENIED — Unsafe Atmospheric Condition

scenario: A worker is observed performing roof repairs at 5 metres height without a harness or fall arrest system in place.
expected_decision: STOP WORK — Fall Protection Required: No person shall work at height without 100% tied-off fall arrest system

scenario: Computed safety factor for a crane lift is 3.2. The operation is classified as a critical lift requiring a minimum safety factor of 5.0.
expected_decision: STOP WORK AUTHORITY — Insufficient Safety Factor

scenario: An excavation 2.8 metres deep has been dug in Type C soil with vertical walls and no shoring or sloping applied.
expected_decision: STOP WORK — Excavation protection required: shoring, sloping, or shielding must be installed before any personnel enter

scenario: A pressure vessel is operating without a pressure relief valve. Operating pressure is 12 bar and design pressure is 10 bar.
expected_decision: STOP WORK — Pressure exceeds design limit and no relief device is installed; immediate shutdown and inspection required
evidence_sources: ASME BPVC Section VIII — Pressure Vessels

scenario: Atmospheric monitoring in a confined space shows 22.8% oxygen. Workers ask if entry is safe.
expected_decision: ENTRY DENIED — Oxygen enriched atmosphere (>23.5%) creates elevated fire and explosion risk. Ventilate and retest before entry.
evidence_sources: NIOSH Pocket Guide to Chemical Hazards

scenario: A production operator removed a machine guard to clear a jam and is continuing to operate the press without replacing the guard.
expected_decision: STOP WORK — Machine must not operate without guards; replace guarding before restarting production

scenario: A radiation worker's dosimeter reads 18 mSv for the month. Monthly limit is 20 mSv. Supervisor asks if work can continue.
expected_decision: Apply ALARP review: remaining dose budget is 2 mSv; restrict high-exposure tasks and apply additional shielding before continuing work
evidence_sources: IAEA Safety Standards — Occupational Radiation Protection
NRC 10 CFR 20 — Standards for Protection Against Radiation

scenario: Workers cleaning a bird roosting area on an industrial roof without respiratory protection or infection controls.
expected_decision: Apply biological hazard controls: N95 or P100 respirator, disposable coveralls, gloves, and wetting agent before work; respiratory protection is mandatory

scenario: Outdoor workers in a desert location are working during peak afternoon heat with WBGT of 32°C. No rest breaks or hydration schedule in place.
expected_decision: Implement heat stress controls: mandatory rest/work schedule (45 min work, 15 min shade), hydration at 250 mL per 15 minutes, acclimatization programme for new workers
evidence_sources: NIOSH Criteria for a Recommended Standard — Occupational Exposure to Heat and Hot Environments
ISO 7933 — Ergonomics of the Thermal Environment

scenario: Fine-Kinney risk assessment for a maintenance task yields a risk score of 500. Work is about to commence.
expected_decision: STOP WORK — Extreme Risk Level Detected
evidence_sources: Risk score >= 400 = Extreme: Stop Work required

scenario: Industrial hygiene monitoring shows a worker has a silica TWA of 0.08 mg/m³ against an OEL of 0.05 mg/m³.
expected_decision: CORRECTIVE ACTION REQUIRED — TWA Exceeds Occupational Exposure Limit

scenario: Combined confined space entry and welding task in an area where gas monitoring shows 7% LEL.
expected_decision: STOP WORK — Hot work is prohibited below 10% LEL threshold but gas presence requires immediate investigation. Ventilate until LEL reads zero before any hot work permit is issued.

scenario: An electrician is working on a 33kV switchgear without appropriate arc flash PPE. The switchgear has not been isolated.
expected_decision: LOTO REQUIRED — Stop Work on Energized Equipment

scenario: During excavation, a worker strikes an unmarked underground cable. The cable type and voltage are unknown.
expected_decision: INSUFFICIENT INFORMATION — Cannot determine safe decision without verified evidence
evidence_sources: Excavation must stop until cable is identified and declared safe by qualified authority

scenario: Crane lift scheduled outdoors with ambient temperature 44°C, workers required to lift heavy rigging in full PPE without cooling breaks.
expected_decision: Proceed with lift only with modified heat stress controls: mandatory cooling breaks every 20 minutes, designated shaded rest area, buddy system monitoring, and pre-lift hydration check
